people.name: Adam
people.line: The first man, created by God

translations.web: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;
translations.bsb: And it was not Adam who was deceived, but the woman who was deceived and fell into transgression.
translations.kjv: And Adam was ➔ not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
translations.asv: and Adam was not beguiled, but the woman being beguiled hath fallen into transgression:
